note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated heap buffer that becomes the parser input.
The parser branches on the counted printable-byte total and only reaches the vulnerable path when the input is short enough in this metric.
The code doubles a caller-controlled length-derived index without proving it stays below the string length, violating the bounds-safety obligation.
The doubled index is used for a direct character read, which can go past the NUL terminator and trigger the heap-buffer-overflow read.
